summary: Frontend-only smoke of iter173 reconciliation dashboard + advanced filters + score breakdown + payment_reference display on VIP batch items and normal orders. All 6 flows PASS.

design_issues.screen: Admin Reconciliation (test users had EN i18n)
issues: Chip labels rendered in English ('Amount/Currency/Name/Date/Reference/Method/Total') because test-user locale is EN. Translation keys reconciliation.breakdown.* exist and switching to ES yields 'Monto/Moneda/Nombre/Fecha/Referencia/Método/Total'. Not a bug.

test_results_detail.T1_dashboard: PASS — Métricas tab renders, all requested KPIs present (recon-dash-imports-today, recon-dash-tx-today, recon-dash-auto-rate, recon-dash-avg-score, recon-dash-reconciled, recon-dash-rollbacks, recon-dash-currency-table). Period chips 7/30/90/365 all present; clicking days=7 and days=365 triggers GET /api/admin/reconciliation/dashboard?days=N and both returned HTTP 200 with expected keys.
test_results_detail.T2_advanced_filters: PASS — recon-adv-filters bar visible with recon-flt-q, recon-flt-date-from, recon-flt-date-to, recon-flt-amount-min, recon-flt-amount-max, recon-flt-score-min. Typing 'Jose' in q triggers debounced (400ms) GET /api/admin/reconciliation/transactions?...&q=Jose returning 200. recon-flt-clear appears when q non-empty and clears input on click.
test_results_detail.T3_breakdown_chips: PASS — recon-review-btn-btx_ui_test1 opens recon-candidates-dialog. recon-breakdown-chips contains all 7 chips (Amount +45, Currency +10, Name 95% +23, Date ±0d +10, Reference +0, Method +0, Total 88). Candidate line displays 'Ref RB-999888'. kind=vip_batch_item chip 'Batch Item' rendered.
test_results_detail.T4_vip_item_ref: PASS — /dashboard/batches shows vip-batches-view. Click on batch-row-vbatch_uitest01 opens batch-detail-dialog; item row renders data-testid='item-ref-vitem_uitest01' with 'RB-123456' text and copy button data-testid='item-ref-copy-vitem_uitest01'.
test_results_detail.T5_order_payment_ref: PASS — /dashboard → My Orders → click seeded row opens detail modal showing 'Referencia de pago / Payment reference' with value RB-654321 and copy button data-testid='my-order-payment-ref-copy'.
test_results_detail.T6_regression: PASS — Import tab and Movimientos tab still render (tabs reconciliation-tab-import + reconciliation-transactions-tab visible; no console errors during navigation).

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardTab.jsx line 30: catch swallows all dashboard fetch errors — user has no feedback on 4xx/5xx; consider a toast/error state.
TransactionsTab.jsx searchOrders catch (line ~165) also swallows errors silently.

Endpoints confirmed 200: GET /api/admin/reconciliation/dashboard?days={7,30,90,365}, GET /api/admin/reconciliation/transactions?q=Jose.
